sector.quote: The Company, with its wholly-owned subsidiaries (together, the "Group"), is a precision engineering business focused on the design, manufacture and support of specialist hole-drilling systems used in the production of aero engine and industrial gas turbine components.

business_description.value: TEK 4 Group is a precision engineering business that designs, manufactures and supports specialist hole-drilling systems used to produce aero engine and industrial gas turbine components. It offers cooling-hole manufacturing solutions including EDM, laser drilling, laser ablation and STEM/ECM.
business_description.quote: The Group provides customers with a broad suite of specialist cooling-hole manufacturing solutions from a single supplier, including electrical discharge machining (EDM), laser drilling, laser ablation and shaped tube electrolytic machining (STEM/ECM), enabling customers to produce the complex cooling-hole geometries required by increasingly high-temperature aero engines and industrial gas turbines.
